messages.author: 13d0e40ead8b0219
messages.subject: two-part models in qtl2
parts:
Hi Karl,

I noticed that in r/qtl, there was an option to use a 2-part model in the scanone function, but this doesn't seem to be an option in r/qtl2.

In this case, what's the best way to deal with a zero-inflated phenotype? Would it make sense to model such a phenotype as two different ones, where one phenotype is either 0 or 1, and the other is the phenotype with all 0 values removed?

Thanks,
Basel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] two-part models in qtl2
parts: "Would it make sense to model such a phenotype as two different ones, where one phenotype is either 0 or 1, and the other is the phenotype with all 0 values removed"

yes that's what I would recommend.

karl
